profile.headline: Front End Web Developer
profile.jobTitle: Front-End Web Developer - Publishing Specialist, Internal Communications
profile.summary:
I'm a front-end developer with a strong foundation in both software engineering and visual design. Over the years, I've honed my skills in translating complex UI/UX needs into clean, efficient, and responsive code. My expertise includes building dynamic web applications, creating responsive email templates, and implementing modern web designs that are both user-friendly and visually engaging.

In addition to my technical skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, I bring a designer's eye for detail to every project, ensuring that the user experience is not only functional but also aesthetically pleasing. Whether it's collaborating with designers to bring concepts to life or optimizing code for performance across devices and browsers, I enjoy working at the intersection of technology and design.

I'm passionate about creating seamless, accessible digital experiences and continuously expanding my knowledge of modern web technologies. I'm currently seeking new opportunities in software engineering and front-end development, where I can apply my skills to develop innovative solutions and contribute to impactful projects.

email: lauraebrown6@gmail.com

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer - Publishing Specialist, Internal Communications
Web Developer
positions.description:
In this role, I modernized user interfaces and optimized internal processes through innovative web development solutions.

Collaborated closely with Product and Engineering teams to breathe new life into Tivian's survey interface. By customizing .tpl templates with CSS, SCSS, and PHP, I helped create a more intuitive and user-friendly experience—all while keeping us on track with project deadlines.

Designed and built a PHP/MySQL tool to replace an outdated audio file system. By integrating Box and Workfront APIs, I automated several processes, cutting manual tasks by 50%. Later, I took it a step further by redeveloping it in React and Node.js to enhance the user experience.

Developed an automated solution using Bash scripts and Gong/Box APIs to transfer over 1,600 recordings and their metadata. This improved data accessibility and saved the company $10K in automation costs.

Revamped internal communication materials by creating responsive email templates with MJML and CSS, testing them with Litmus to ensure they looked great everywhere. This effort significantly improved consistency and visual appeal across our digital platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: SCSS · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Front-End Development · GitHub · Node.js · Front End Engineering Design (FEED) · React.js · RESTful WebServices · MJML · Web Applications · Web Development

positions.title: Technical Designer
positions.description:
In this role, I leveraged my knowledge of the Motion Graphic Design team's standards and processes to develop tools that enhanced efficiency and creativity.

Collaborated with the Creative team to standardize processes and gather feedback on existing tools, leading to the development of new solutions that streamlined workflows.

Built a variety of tools primarily using JavaScript and ExtendScript, providing designers with greater creative flexibility through easy-to-use UI panels that condensed processes into single button clicks.

Played a key role in saving GuideSpark nearly $25,000 in setup costs by meticulously testing a new web tool. This ensured a smooth installation and allowed designers to work more efficiently. I continued to research and test the tool, keeping it updated with software enhancements and new features.

Established a standard process for setting up character animations, which significantly improved the quality of customer videos. Leveraged tools such as After Effects, Duik, AE Expressions, and ExtendScript to simplify the rigging process.

As the role evolved to meet business needs, I ensured my team stayed up-to-date on advancements in Adobe tools and scripting languages.

positions.title: Designer
positions.description:
I designed and edited motion graphics videos on Human Resources topics such as benefit offerings and performance management. To create these videos, I collaborated with Writers, Quality Control, and Art Directors to ensure accuracy and consistency of style.

Throughout the year, but particularly during the company’s busy season, I balanced multiple deliverables per day. I also trained contractors and new hires on video creation and asset use.

The strict video timelines require efficiency, and I leveraged pre-existing content and maintained file organization to set the entire Design team up for success on each video and its successive edits.

positions.title: Content Production Specialist
positions.description: I customized and edited scripts and videos in the production of motion graphics presentations on Human Resources topics. Primarily, these customizations required translating lengthy benefit offerings documents, such as medical plan descriptions, to short video segments.

positions.title: Marketplace Research Contract Employee
positions.description:
I was responsible for conducting research on factual (non-fiction) television trends for use in content development decisions at the station. 

My research involved an audit of programming schedules, television show descriptions, and gaining insight into genres of factual television. I documented this information in Excel, and then worked with the Graphics department to create a visual representation of these trends for poster display.

courses.name: SMC Office of Sustainability Master Resource Conservation Course

volunteerExperiences.description:
CACC is a local animal foster network in the Bay Area, where I volunteer with technical and programming expertise, and publish content via the WordPress-based website.

I also provide instruction and insight to center’s marketing and leadership teams, assist in website administration, data aggregation, and technical documentation.

I get to volunteer with dogs! As a volunteer, I spend time with the dogs at the shelter, going on walks and playing with them. For all the dogs, it provides much-needed outdoor time and fun. For the more shy or reactive dogs, this time spent is valuable learning and bonding time, getting them used to interaction with humans, other dogs, and the outside world. Pets in Need is an amazing shelter and I'm so lucky to get to volunteer there.
